kjv: let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing
mine: let us hold true to what we have attained
note: TR adds "kanoni, to auto phronein"; absent from P16, P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B.

kjv: For our conversation is in heaven
mine: But our citizenship is in heaven
note: politeuma is citizenship or commonwealth (pointed at Philippi, a Roman colony); "conversation" (1611: manner of life) is now meaningless here.

kjv: who (Christ) shall change our vile body
mine: who (Christ) will transform our lowly body
note: soma tes tapeinoseos is the body of humiliation; "vile" (1611: lowly) now means disgusting.
